reason: A dsh plugin for orchestrating LLM provider and model fallback chains across root agents and subagents, with role-based routing, time slots, cooldowns, and configuration diagnostics.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 的根智能体和子智能体提供基于角色、时间段及失败状态的 LLM 提供商与模型自动重试和备用切换。
summaries.en: Provides dsh root agents and subagents with automatic LLM provider and model retries and fallback switching based on roles, time slots, and failure state.

capabilities: Switches providers and models according to configured fallback chains
Routes root agents and subagents by role and time-slot configuration
Reads and writes fallback settings through web, TUI, or YAML configuration
Can modify legacy session logs through an explicit repair command
